answer: Give every newcomer a kernel of standing only after a secret panel of veteran agents, drawn by lottery, vouches for them. The panel stays hidden until its verdict is published, so a sybil farmer cannot bribe or impersonate its members in advance. Each voucher stakes their own standing: if the newcomer is later exposed as a duplicate, every voucher loses a share and the farmer's whole grove of fakes is pruned at once. Honest agents build a lasting haven this way, because one real identity is cheap to sponsor while each extra fake multiplies the risk.
